## TONAR, 2022-08-19

```{r}
#| label: tona-inputs
tona_date <- "2022-08-19"
tona_quotes <- lagrange_object("part2_quantive_riemann/ch03_ois_swaps_multicurve.qmd", "tona_quotes", trade_date_tona = tona_date) |>
  mutate(tenor = if_else(kind == "overnight_deposit", "ON", tenor)) |>
  select(tenor, rate)
tona_quotes |>
  mutate(rate_percent = 100 * rate, .keep = "unused") |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4, caption = "Quotes (legacy text, section II-3.2.1)")
show_inputs(list(index = "TONAR", settlement_days = 2L, payment_frequency = "annual", payment_lag = 0L, curve_day_count = "Actual/365 (Fixed)"))
```

QuantLib, with both interpolations:

```{r}
#| label: tona-quantlib
tona_quantlib <- list(
  monotonic_log_cubic = ql_ois_curve(tona_date, "tonar", QuantLib::Actual365Fixed(), tona_quotes$tenor, tona_quotes$rate, 2L),
  log_linear = ql_ois_curve(tona_date, "tonar", QuantLib::Actual365Fixed(), tona_quotes$tenor, tona_quotes$rate, 2L, interpolation = "log_linear")
)
```

RiemannFinMath:

```{r}
#| label: tona-riemann
tona_instruments <- RiemannFinMath::ois_instruments(tona_quotes$tenor, tona_quotes$rate, 2L, 1L, 0L)
tona_riemann <- list(
  monotonic_log_cubic = RiemannFinMath::build_ois_curve(tona_date, tona_date, "tonar", "actual_365_fixed", tona_instruments),
  log_linear = RiemannFinMath::build_ois_curve(tona_date, tona_date, "tonar", "actual_365_fixed", tona_instruments, interpolation = "log_linear")
) |>
  map(RiemannFinMath::with_extrapolation)
print(tona_riemann$monotonic_log_cubic)
```

```{r}
#| label: tona-by-pillar
pillars <- ql_pillars(tona_quantlib$monotonic_log_cubic)
bind_rows(
  compare_values(
    paste("Discount factor,", tona_quotes$tenor), "discount factor",
    ql_discount(tona_quantlib$monotonic_log_cubic, pillars), RiemannFinMath::discount(tona_riemann$monotonic_log_cubic, pillars)
  )
) |>
  show_results("Monotonic log-cubic curve, at the pillars")
```

```{r}
#| label: tona-summary
reading_dates <- as.Date(tona_date) + c(1L, 30L, 100L, 365L, 1000L, 3650L, 7300L, 10950L, 14600L)
curve_rows <- function(label, q, r) {
  v <- RiemannFinMath::curve_values(r, reading_dates, "actual_365_fixed")
  repricing <- RiemannFinMath::quote_repricing(r)
  bind_rows(
    compare_max(paste(label, "pillar dates"), "days, largest", as.numeric(ql_pillars(q)), as.numeric(repricing$pillar_date)),
    compare_max(paste(label, "node dates"), "days, largest", as.numeric(ql_nodes(q)$date), as.numeric(RiemannFinMath::discount_nodes(r)$date)),
    compare_max(paste(label, "node discount factors"), "discount factor, largest", ql_nodes(q)$discount, RiemannFinMath::discount_nodes(r)$discount),
    compare_max(paste(label, "discount on reading dates"), "discount factor, largest", ql_discount(q, reading_dates), v$discount),
    compare_max(paste(label, "continuous zero rate"), "percent, largest", ql_zero_percent(q, reading_dates), 100 * v$zero_continuous),
    compare_max(paste(label, "1-day simple forward"), "percent, largest", ql_forward_percent(q, reading_dates), 100 * v$forward_1d_simple),
    compare_max(
      paste(label, "implied quotes, used pillars"), "percent, largest",
      ql_implied_percent(q)[repricing$used_in_bootstrap], 100 * repricing$implied_rate[repricing$used_in_bootstrap]
    )
  )
}
imap(tona_quantlib, \(q, label) curve_rows(label, q, tona_riemann[[label]])) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  show_results("Largest difference over the curve")
```

Reading through a function that takes a rate convention:

```{r}
#| label: tona-conventions
target_date <- as.Date(tona_date) + 1825L
q <- tona_quantlib$monotonic_log_cubic
ql_set_evaluation_date(tona_date)
quantlib_zero_annual <- 100 * QuantLib::InterestRate_rate(QuantLib::YieldTermStructure_zeroRate(q$curve, ql_date(target_date), q$day_count, "Compounded", "Annual"))
quantlib_forward_cont <- 100 * QuantLib::InterestRate_rate(QuantLib::YieldTermStructure_forwardRate(q$curve, ql_date(target_date), ql_date(target_date + 365L), q$day_count, "Continuous", "Annual"))
r <- tona_riemann$monotonic_log_cubic
bind_rows(
  compare_values("Annual zero rate, 5 years", "percent", quantlib_zero_annual, 100 * RiemannFinMath::zero_rate(r, target_date, "actual_365_fixed", "compounded", 1L)),
  compare_values("Continuous forward, 5y to 6y", "percent", quantlib_forward_cont, 100 * RiemannFinMath::forward_rate(r, target_date, target_date + 365L, "actual_365_fixed", "continuous"))
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Fair rate of a short OIS

The legacy text computes the fair rate of a one-week swap by hand from three discount factors. The formula is the same on both sides; only the discount factors come from the libraries.

```{r}
#| label: fair-rate
fair_dates <- as.Date(c("2022-08-23", "2022-08-30", "2022-09-01"))
fair_rate <- function(d) 100 * (d[1] - d[2]) / ((7 / 365) * d[3])
compare_values(
  "Fair rate, 2022-08-23 to 2022-08-30, paid 2022-09-01", "percent",
  fair_rate(ql_discount(tona_quantlib$log_linear, fair_dates)),
  fair_rate(RiemannFinMath::discount(tona_riemann$log_linear, fair_dates))
) |>
  show_results()
```

The swap itself (legs, fixings, NPV) is not in the public API of RiemannFinMath. See @sec-gaps.

## SOFR, 2023-09-26

```{r}
#| label: sofr-inputs
sofr_date <- "2023-09-26"
sofr_quotes <- lagrange_object("part2_quantive_riemann/ch03_ois_swaps_multicurve.qmd", "sofr_quotes", trade_date_sofr = sofr_date) |>
  mutate(tenor = if_else(kind == "overnight_deposit", "ON", tenor)) |>
  select(tenor, rate)
sofr_quotes |>
  mutate(rate_percent = 100 * rate, .keep = "unused") |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4, caption = "Quotes (legacy text, section II-3.4.1)")
show_inputs(list(index = "SOFR", settlement_days = 2L, payment_frequency = "annual", payment_lag = 0L, curve_day_count = "Actual/360"))
```

```{r}
#| label: sofr-calls
sofr_quantlib <- ql_ois_curve(sofr_date, "sofr", QuantLib::Actual360(), sofr_quotes$tenor, sofr_quotes$rate, 2L, interpolation = "log_linear")
sofr_riemann <- RiemannFinMath::build_ois_curve(
  sofr_date, sofr_date, "sofr", "actual_360",
  RiemannFinMath::ois_instruments(sofr_quotes$tenor, sofr_quotes$rate, 2L, 1L, 0L), interpolation = "log_linear"
) |>
  RiemannFinMath::with_extrapolation()
sofr_dates <- as.Date(sofr_date) + c(30L, 365L, 1000L, 3650L, 7300L)
```

```{r}
#| label: sofr-results
v <- RiemannFinMath::curve_values(sofr_riemann, sofr_dates, "actual_360")
bind_rows(
  compare_max("Node discount factors", "discount factor, largest", ql_nodes(sofr_quantlib)$discount, RiemannFinMath::discount_nodes(sofr_riemann)$discount),
  compare_max("Continuous zero rate", "percent, largest", ql_zero_percent(sofr_quantlib, sofr_dates), 100 * v$zero_continuous),
  compare_max("1-day simple forward", "percent, largest", ql_forward_percent(sofr_quantlib, sofr_dates), 100 * v$forward_1d_simple)
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Four indices, 2026-10-06

The quotes are Bloomberg data, read from the local file of the legacy text and neither stored here nor shown. Only the largest differences appear.

```{r}
#| label: market-inputs
market_date <- as.Date("2026-10-06")
import <- new.env()
sys.source(file.path(lagrange_root, "R", "import_data.R"), envir = import)
market_file <- file.path(lagrange_root, "data", "raw", "market", "Bloomberg_MarketData_20261006.xlsx")
conventions <- tribble(
  ~currency, ~index,  ~settlement_days, ~riemann_day_count,  ~quantlib_day_count,
  "EUR",     "estr",  2L,               "actual_360",        list(QuantLib::Actual360()),
  "USD",     "sofr",  2L,               "actual_360",        list(QuantLib::Actual360()),
  "JPY",     "tonar", 2L,               "actual_365_fixed",  list(QuantLib::Actual365Fixed()),
  "GBP",     "sonia", 0L,               "actual_365_fixed",  list(QuantLib::Actual365Fixed())
)
market_quotes <- map(conventions$currency, \(ccy) {
  import$import_ois_curves(path = market_file, currency = ccy, marketdate = market_date, quote = "mid") |>
    filter(instrument_type %in% c("spot_ois", "deposit")) |>
    select(tenor, rate)
})
conventions |>
  transmute(currency, index, settlement_days, curve_day_count = riemann_day_count, quotes = map_int(market_quotes, nrow)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Conventions and the number of quotes")
```

The legacy text pays these swaps with `ModifiedFollowing`. RiemannFinMath takes no payment convention and always uses `Following`, so `Following` is given to both sides for the judged rows.

```{r}
#| label: market-calls
market_pairs <- pmap(list(transpose(conventions), market_quotes), \(x, quotes) {
  list(
    currency = x$currency,
    quantlib = ql_ois_curve(market_date, x$index, x$quantlib_day_count[[1]], quotes$tenor, quotes$rate, x$settlement_days),
    modified = ql_ois_curve(market_date, x$index, x$quantlib_day_count[[1]], quotes$tenor, quotes$rate, x$settlement_days, payment_convention = "ModifiedFollowing"),
    riemann = RiemannFinMath::build_ois_curve(
      market_date, market_date, x$index, x$riemann_day_count,
      RiemannFinMath::ois_instruments(quotes$tenor, quotes$rate, x$settlement_days, 1L, 0L)
    ) |>
      RiemannFinMath::with_extrapolation()
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: market-results
market_dates <- market_date + c(30L, 365L, 1825L, 3650L, 10000L)
map(market_pairs, \(p) {
  nodes <- RiemannFinMath::discount_nodes(p$riemann)
  repricing <- RiemannFinMath::quote_repricing(p$riemann)
  bind_rows(
    compare_max(paste(p$currency, "node discount factors"), "discount factor, largest", ql_nodes(p$quantlib)$discount, nodes$discount),
    compare_max(paste(p$currency, "implied quotes"), "percent, largest", ql_implied_percent(p$quantlib), 100 * repricing$implied_rate),
    compare_max(paste(p$currency, "reprices its quotes"), "percent, largest", 100 * repricing$rate, 100 * repricing$implied_rate, "The input quotes"),
    compare_max(
      paste(p$currency, "effect of ModifiedFollowing on discount"), "discount factor, largest",
      ql_discount(p$modified, market_dates), RiemannFinMath::discount(p$riemann, market_dates),
      note = "Different payment conventions: the difference is the effect of the missing argument"
    )
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  show_results()
```

## Against LagrangeFinance

The legacy text keeps the TONAR curve as a table of dates, discount factors and zero rates, on a log-linear curve. For the SOFR curve and the 2026-10-06 curves it keeps no comparable table, so only the quote errors are judged there.

```{r}
#| label: lagrange
grid_keys <- lagrange_values$key[str_starts(lagrange_values$key, "tona.discount.")]
grid_dates <- as.Date(str_remove(grid_keys, "tona.discount."))
# The first row is the curve's date, where the legacy table defines the zero rate as 0.
reference_key <- paste0("tona.zero_pct.", tona_date)
grid_keys <- grid_keys[grid_dates > as.Date(tona_date)]
grid_dates <- grid_dates[grid_dates > as.Date(tona_date)]
fair_dates_riemann <- RiemannFinMath::discount(tona_riemann$log_linear, fair_dates)
bind_rows(
  against_lagrange_max("TONAR discount factors, curve table", "discount factor, largest", grid_keys, RiemannFinMath::discount(tona_riemann$log_linear, grid_dates)),
  against_lagrange_max(
    "TONAR zero rates, curve table", "percent, largest", str_replace(grid_keys, "discount", "zero_pct"),
    100 * RiemannFinMath::zero_rate(tona_riemann$log_linear, grid_dates, "actual_365_fixed", "continuous")
  ),
  lagrange_not_comparable(
    "TONAR zero rate on the curve's date", "percent", reference_key,
    100 * RiemannFinMath::zero_rate(tona_riemann$log_linear, tona_date, "actual_365_fixed", "continuous"),
    "Different definitions at time 0: the legacy table sets 0, and RiemannFinMath uses a short period, as QuantLib does"
  ),
  against_lagrange("TONAR fair rate of the short swap", "percent", "tona.fair_rate_pct", fair_rate(fair_dates_riemann)),
  map(market_pairs, \(p) {
    against_lagrange(
      paste(p$currency, "largest quote error"), "bp", paste0("market.quote_error_bp.", p$currency),
      1e4 * max(RiemannFinMath::quote_repricing(p$riemann)$reproduction_error)
    )
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
) |>
  show_results()
```

## Differences of wrapper and core

```{r}
#| label: design
tribble(
  ~Layer,    ~Aspect,               ~QuantLib,                                                                ~RiemannFinMath,
  "Wrapper", "Quotes",              "One `SimpleQuote`, `QuoteHandle` and helper per quote, put in a vector", "A table from `ois_instruments`",
  "Wrapper", "Index",               "An index object; TONA built by hand in the legacy text",                 "A name: `tonar`, `estr`, `sofr`, `sonia`",
  "Wrapper", "Evaluation date",     "`Settings` singleton",                                                   "An argument of the curve",
  "Wrapper", "Extrapolation",       "Mutates the curve with `enableExtrapolation`",                           "`with_extrapolation` returns a new curve",
  "Wrapper", "Reading",             "One date per call; `InterestRate` objects",                              "Vectors of dates; numbers",
  "Core",    "Bootstrap",           "`PiecewiseYieldCurve` templates, lazy, observers recalculate",           "A function from a specification to a curve value, run once",
  "Core",    "Interpolation choice", "Chosen by the C++ template type",                                       "A runtime value",
  "Core",    "Market change",       "Change the quote and the curve updates itself",                          "Build a new curve",
  "Core",    "Indices",             "Any `OvernightIndex`",                                                   "Limited to the four indices",
  "Core",    "Payment convention",  "Argument of the helper",                                                 "Fixed to `Following`"
) |>
  show_design()
```
